description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a protected object belongs
description_zh: 修改防护对象所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi change-resource-group --resource-id demo.aliyun.com-waf --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2mcq000 --resource-type defenseresource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF resource to operate on
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group. You can view available resource groups in the resource group console
parameters.help_zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Fixed value: defenseresource
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。固定取值：defenseresource
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
